description:
Unitree Robotics has just revealed new footage of its G1 AI robot, and the internet is freaking out over how scarily human it moves. In this video, we break down the latest upgrades that give the G1 smoother balance, faster reaction speed, and natural motion control that looks shockingly close to real human biomechanics.

Powered by advanced actuators, full-body coordination, and next-generation artificial intelligence, the G1 is now performing tasks and movement sequences that were impossible for small humanoids just a year ago. From precise stepping to fluid arm motion, every part of its movement shows how quickly AI robots are evolving.
